title: Shevna, a man of Jerusalem

paragraphs: Mentioned in Shabbat 12b, and Rashi explained that he was a great man.[^1]

notes.text: יב: gives Shabbat 12b under the colon convention, without independent named-edition verification. The “great man” description remains attributed to Rashi as Hyman reports it; no personal title is added to Shevna.
